description:
Troubleshoot connection issues for the 'Finance' team. 
1. Navigate to the Jitsi meeting room 'FinanceTroubleshoot' (http://localhost:8080/FinanceTroubleshoot).
2. Open the Firefox Developer Tools (F12) and select the 'Console' tab.
3. Reload the page while the Console is open to capture the full initialization sequence.
4. Once the meeting connects, copy the console logs.
5. Save the logs to a text file at '/home/ga/jitsi_debug.log'.
6. Take a screenshot showing the Developer Tools Console open alongside the meeting window and save it to '/home/ga/console_evidence.png'.
